cases.sentence: Было ко мне слово ___, сын человеческий, скажи правителю Тира.
cases.translation: The word of the Lord came to me, son of man, tell the prince of Tyre.
cases.explain: The phrase 'слово Господа' uses the genitive to show possession of the word.

cases.sentence: Так говорит владыка Господь, объятый гордыней ты говоришь, я Бог, я сижу на Божьем престоле посреди ___.
cases.translation: The Lord God says, 'Overcome with pride you say: I am a god, I sit on God's throne in the middle of the sea.'
cases.explain: The preposition 'посреди' (in the middle of) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ты думаешь, что ты мудрее ___? Нет, для тебя неведомы тайны.
cases.translation: Do you think you are wiser than Daniel? No, mysteries are hidden from you.
cases.explain: The adjective 'мудрее' (wiser) in the comparative form takes the genitive case for the object of comparison.

cases.sentence: Мудростью и умом ты приобрел богатство, ты наполнил золотом и серебром свои ___.
cases.translation: By wisdom and understanding you have gained wealth; you have filled your treasuries with gold and silver.
cases.explain: The verb 'наполнил' (filled) with direct object 'treasuries' requires the accusative plural.

cases.sentence: На твои красоту и мудрость они обнажат мечи и осквернят твой ___.
cases.translation: Against your beauty and wisdom they will draw their swords and defile your splendor.
cases.explain: The verb 'осквернят' (will defile) with direct object 'splendor' requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ты был примером совершенства, исполненной мудрости и безупречной ___.
cases.translation: You were the model of perfection, full of wisdom and flawless in beauty.
cases.explain: The noun phrase 'примером совершенства, мудрости и красоты' uses the genitive in parallel construction.

cases.sentence: Ты был в Эдеме, в Божьем ___. Все драгоценные камни тебя украшали.
cases.translation: You were in Eden, God's garden. Every precious stone adorned you.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) with location in the dative case: 'в саду' (in the garden).

cases.sentence: Ты был помазан быть охраняющим Херувимом, ведь я осветил тебя. Ты был на святой Божьей горе и ходил среди горящих ___.
cases.translation: You were anointed to be the covering cherub, for I made you luminous. You were on God's holy mountain and walked among fiery stones.
cases.explain: The preposition 'среди' (among) with 'stones' requires the genitive plural: 'среди горящих камней' (among the fiery stones).

reading.ru: Так говорит владыка Господь, объятый гордыней ты говоришь, я Бог, я сижу на Божьем престоле посреди моря, но ты человек, не Бог.
reading.question: What claim does the prince of Tyre make, and what does God correct?
options: The prince claims to be a god on God's throne in the sea, but God says he is only a man, not a god
The prince claims to be the wisest ruler
The prince claims to control the seas
The prince claims to have defeated all enemies
reading.correct: The prince claims to be a god on God's throne in the sea, but God says he is only a man, not a god
reading.explain: The text shows Tyre's pride: 'я Бог, я сижу на Божьем престоле' and God's correction: 'но ты человек, не Бог' — you are man, not God.

reading.ru: Мудростью и умом ты приобрел богатство, ты наполнил золотом и серебром свои кладовые.
reading.question: How did the prince of Tyre gain his wealth?
options: Through wisdom and understanding he gained riches and filled his treasuries with gold and silver
By inheriting it from his ancestors
reading.correct: Through wisdom and understanding he gained riches and filled his treasuries with gold and silver
reading.explain: The text states: 'Мудростью и умом ты приобрел богатство, ты наполнил золотом и серебром свои кладовые' — through wisdom and understanding you gained wealth and filled your treasuries with gold and silver.

reading.ru: Ты был примером совершенства, исполненной мудрости и безупречной красоты».
reading.question: How is the king of Tyre initially described?
options: The model of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty
A tyrant and a cruel ruler
reading.correct: The model of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty
reading.explain: The lament describes him: 'примером совершенства, исполненной мудрости и безупречной красоты' — the model of perfection, full of wisdom and flawless beauty.

reading.ru: Ты был в Эдеме, в Божьем саду. Все драгоценные камни тебя украшали, рубин, топаз, изумруд, хризалит, оникс и яшма, сапфир, бирюза и берил.
reading.question: What precious stones adorned the king of Tyre?
options: Ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl
No precious stones, only fine clothing
reading.correct: Ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl
reading.explain: The text lists the stones: 'рубин, топаз, изумруд, хризалит, оникс и яшма, сапфир, бирюза и берил' — ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl.

reading.ru: От размаха своей торговли ты исполнился неправды и согрешил.
reading.question: What caused the king's downfall?
options: From the extent of his commerce he became filled with unrighteousness and sinned
He was defeated by a military rival
He angered the gods through sacrifice
reading.correct: From the extent of his commerce he became filled with unrighteousness and sinned
reading.explain: The moral decline is described: 'От размаха своей торговли ты исполнился неправды и согрешил' — by the vastness of your commerce you became full of unrighteousness and sinned.

reading.ru: Я вывел из тебя огонь, который тебя поглотил. Я превратил тебя в пепел на земле, на глазах у всех, кто смотрел.
reading.question: What is the final judgment that God pronounces upon Tyre?
options: Fire will come out of you and consume you, and you will become ashes on the earth in the sight of all who look
You will be restored to power
A new king will bring glory to your throne
reading.correct: Fire will come out of you and consume you, and you will become ashes on the earth in the sight of all who look
reading.explain: The final judgment: 'Я вывел из тебя огонь, который тебя поглотил. Я превратил тебя в пепел на земле' — I will bring fire from you that will consume you and turn you to ashes.
